Clay shooting, step by step

One Academy for everyone who shoots or helps shooters. Pick your route, read short lessons, practise on the games and get a certificate. Terms are in English, as they are said on the stand.

Who are you?

BeginnerFor someone who has never shot.19 lessons · ≈ 1 h 45 minFirst competitionFor a shooter after a few sessions.27 lessons · ≈ 2 h 32 minInterpreterFor interpreters on the stand; replaces the Interpreter Academy.59 lessons · ≈ 5 h 41 minParents of a juniorFor parents whose child wants to shoot.15 lessons · ≈ 1 h 18 min

Topics

BasicsWhat the sport is, the disciplines, FITASC, the shooting ground, who shoots, how to start, what it costs and how a child can start.11 lessonsSafety & etiquetteSafety habits, eye and ear protection, lead, children; behaviour on the stand and in the group, respect for the referee, spectators.8 lessonsGearThe gun, chokes, cartridges, protection and clothing: what things are called, how they work, what to buy and when.26 lessonsTargets & flight linesTargets, traps, Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting layouts, menus, flight lines, doubles and how to read a target.12 lessonsTechnique & leadStance, gun mount, eyes, the three points, follow-through, recoil; the four lead methods; reading misses.15 lessonsTrainingThe coach, how to structure and dose training, warm-up, dry mount practice, preparing for a competition, a training diary.7 lessonsMind & preparationPre-shot routine, attention, breathing, cue words, imagery, nerves, pressure, resetting after a miss, goals, competition day, anti-doping, juniors.12 lessonsRulesFITASC rules in plain words, short and in our own words; every rule is marked Sporting™ or Compak® Sporting and links to the rules guide.8 lessonsCompetitionsTypes of competition, entering, competition day, the score card and results, categories and shoot-offs, protests, juniors.7 lessonsTravelPlanning a trip, the gun in the EU and outside it, flying, cartridges at the destination, jet lag; ClayAway tours (coming soon).7 lessonsStand TalkHow the coach, the referee and shooters talk; the interpreter's work; for everyone who trains with a coach who speaks another language.11 lessonsWatch & followHow to watch shooting and videos; ClayArena: results, profile, numbers, catalogues.6 lessonsCommunity & historyHistory, traditions, nature, the club; how to become a referee or a coach; a club shoot.10 lessons
